definitions: 蒸馏；通过加热使液体中的成分汽化，再冷凝收集，以分离或提纯物质的过程。

examples.text: So for thousands of years, alcohol content was limited. That changed with the invention of a process called distillation. 9th century Arabic writings describe boiling fermented liquids to vaporize the alcohol in them.
examples.explanation: 这里 distillation 指“蒸馏”这种工艺：把发酵液加热，使酒精汽化并被分离出来，因此酒精含量不再只受普通发酵的限制。

source.text: A brief history of alcohol - Rod Phillips

relations.reason: desalination 可通过蒸馏等工艺去除海水盐分，distillation 是相关的分离/净化过程，具有明确的技术关联和学习价值。
